scope: Complete native E4 weight-resident QKV with four weighted activation terms and canonical output-row lanes. All quantization, replication, TRF loads, head arithmetic and stores are included; no internal NPU attribution was collected.

adoption.reason: This single allocation did not show a net gain. Preserve it; root decides whether a concrete unresolved variance or implementation issue justifies another check.

further_tuning.reason: 5% is a provisional additional-tuning budget, not an adoption minimum. No tile sweep is authorized by this report.

major_research.question: Can activation-resident native weight streaming avoid E136 bulk weight-TRF loading and full-H four-term stream replication while preserving weighted-term accuracy? E136 has no internal NPU cost attribution.

decisions.decision_owner: Root reviewer; these are evidence-based proposed next actions, not an automatic adoption.
